confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from several conflicting, partly undated aggregator and venue-menu results; no Matsuyama-wide drink survey was found. Beer excludes happy-hour promotions. Mid-range meal for two is the least certain food anchor (one aggregator implies about USD 33). Wine glass rests on four menu listings at JPY 600-880, not all confirmed in Matsuyama. Cocktail rests on one listed price (about USD 8) plus a cheaper lemon-style item, and is set at about 1.9x beer per the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private hostel, 1-star, 3-star) are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against listings. Yen figures use an assumed JPY 155 per USD, not the RBA rate; a 10 percent yen move shifts them by about 10 percent. The FX value came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the F11 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: a mid-sized Japanese prefectural capital priced below Tokyo and Osaka. Restaurant anchors follow Matsuyama-listed figures, including a Numbeo inexpensive-meal figure of about JPY 1,000; Tokyo expat-area cafe prices (about JPY 600) serve as an upper bound. Accommodation tiers rest on general knowledge of regional Japanese hotels.
